work_unit: native work range over source program instances (or legally repartitioned output tiles) executed by one persistent worker thread

distribution.mechanism: the generated program computes each worker's range from (worker_id, worker_count) at runtime after reading --threads; a persistent pthread pool created once per process by the native runtime executes the ranges (OS-scheduled Linux threads; standard threads drive scalar/vector/matrix compute alike)
partitions: strided round-robin over source program instances (default; every program instance executes exactly once across workers)
contiguous chunks over output tiles when repartitioning from the source grid is legal (disjoint output ownership)
two-phase partial reduction with explicit merge stage for cross-worker reductions
single-worker serial execution of the full range (worker_count=1 is a configuration of the same artifact)

synchronization: pthread barriers at declared stage boundaries, provided by the native runtime
C11 atomics for cross-worker partials and for the source's own atomic operations (sem/scope mapped to the declared RVWMO model with explicit synchronization)
cross-worker memory visibility is established only at the declared stage barriers; no implicit coherence is assumed

safety.condition: concurrent workers are valid when every source program instance executes exactly once, output ownership is disjoint or combined through the source's own atomics or an explicit merge stage, and cross-worker visibility is established by the declared barriers; tails, ownership, visibility and repeated execution are validated at 1/2/4/8 workers
safety.fallback: the same artifact runs serially with worker_count=1: one worker executes the full range and stage barriers degrade to no-ops; there is no separate serial binary
